samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable depth and width.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal used for synchronous write operations.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal used for synchronous read operations.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal. Used to trigger write operations.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal. Used to trigger read operations.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal. Indicates if the FIFO is full and cannot accept further write operations.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal. Indicates if the FIFO is empty and cannot provide any data for read operations.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH" value="8">FIFO data width.</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH" value="16">FIFO depth.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="waddr_bin" width_description="[DEPTH-1:0]" description="Binary write address." />
        <register id="raddr_bin" width_description="[DEPTH-1:0]" description="Binary read address." />
        <register id="wptr" width_description="[4:0]" description="Gray code write pointer." />
        <register id="rptr" width_description="[4:0]" description="Gray code read pointer." />
        <register id="wptr_buff" width_description="[4:0]" description="Buffer for write pointer." />
        <register id="rptr_buff" width_description="[4:0]" description="Buffer for read pointer." />
        <wire id="wen" description="Write enable signal." />
        <wire id="ren" description="Read enable signal." />
        <wire id="wfull_int" description="Internal write full signal." />
        <wire id="rempty_int" description="Internal read empty signal." />
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        <!-- Dual-Port RAM Instantiation -->
        <submodule id="dual_port_RAM" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]" depth_description="[DEPTH-1:0]" />

        <!-- Write Pointer Logic -->
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
                wptr <= 0;
            end else if (winc && !wfull_int) begin
                waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                wptr <= {~wptr[3], wptr[2:0]};
            end
        end

        <!-- Read Pointer Logic -->
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
                rptr <= 0;
            end else if (rinc && !rempty_int) begin
                raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                rptr <= {~rptr[3], rptr[2:0]};
            end
        end

        <!-- Gray Code Conversion -->
        assign wptr_buff = wptr;
        assign rptr_buff = rptr;

        <!-- Full and Empty Signals -->
        assign wfull_int = (wptr == {~rptr[3], rptr[2:0]});
        assign rempty_int = (rptr == wptr);

        <!-- Control Signals for RAM -->
        assign wen = winc && !wfull_int && rrstn;
        assign ren = rinc && !rempty_int && wrstn;

        <!-- Connect to Dual-Port RAM -->
        dual_port_RAM.wclk <= wclk;
        dual_port_RAM.wenc <= wen;
        dual_port_RAM.waddr <= waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];
        dual_port_RAM.wdata <= wdata;
        dual_port_RAM.rclk <= rclk;
        dual_port_RAM.renc <= ren;
        dual_port_RAM.raddr <= raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0];
        rdata <= dual_port_RAM.rdata;

        <!-- Outputs -->
        wfull <= wfull_int;
        rempty <= rempty_int;
    </implementation>
</module>
